parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are documented and substantial: a top-court ruling defining sex as biological for equality-act purposes that reaches single-sex services, changing rooms and hostels; interim strip-search by birth sex in the transport police; biological-sex searching in one regional police service; prison-housing guidance struck down but government defending risk-assessment flexibility; and a statutory code in force from August 2026 with UN experts warning of exclusion. A documented death of a trans woman allegedly linked to ward-placement practice and a hospital ward-ban plan add institutional exposure. Offsets: GRC issuance continues, the top court preserved gender-reassignment discrimination protection, hate-crime coverage is partial, and same-sex marriage is legal. The rainbow-index decline and hostile national media show a deteriorating climate. Unresolved litigation and one undocumented regional policy are noted as open questions, not weighted as exposure. Universal facility exposure with partial recourse places this in the Elevated band.
